batting.name: AM Rahane
batting.dismissal: c KL Rahul b MJ Henry

batting.name: DJ Mitchell
batting.dismissal: c DJ Hooda b Yash Thakur

batting.name: RA Jadeja
batting.dismissal: c KL Rahul b Mohsin Khan

batting.name: S Dube
batting.dismissal: run out (Q de Kock, MP Stoinis)

batting.name: KL Rahul
batting.dismissal: c RD Gaikwad b Mustafizur Rahman

batting.name: N Pooran
batting.dismissal: c SN Thakur b M Pathirana

balls.text: he bhas converted the yorker into a full toss by staying deep in his crease, and whacks this over midwicket for a four. Doesn't get all of it but enough still to hit a boundary
huge roar as Gaikwad mis-hits for just a single. Shuffles across, Stoinis follows him with a wide yorker. Just the single. Dhoni on strike

full and wide, out of his swinging arc, hit straight to extra cover. Gaikwad this time says he wants the strike back. Dube is caught short at the non-striker's end. Gine for 66 off 27. Huge roar in the ground because they are expecting Dhoni with two balls to go
short, wide, high, upper-cut to the left of deep third for another couple
draws the mis-hit with the bouncer but the mis-hit is so big it falls well short of long-on. Gaikwad is willing to sacrifice his wicket to get Dube on strike, but QdeK misses by a long way
out of the screws. Stoinis does the right thing. Into the pitch, outside off, but Dube still smashes the pull shot rows behind deep midwicket for a six
slower length ball, big swing from Gaikwad and he misses
another drop, this time from a man not used to keeping but who must field because the captain insists on keeping. Hit high to extra cover, where QdeK drops another catch for LSG
slower ball, wide, on a length, and Dube has somehow smashed it for a flat six straight of long-on. Everything must go. Dube gets to his fifty
wide half-volley with a deep cover in place, but Dube has drilled it straight of that man. Uff what power. Deep cover doesn't have much to move, but he still can't catch up
full, outside off, drilled to extra cover for a dot
huge six. Short of a length, sits up, Dube is in too good a form to miss out. Pulls it well over cow corner
gets the wide yorker right, dub out back to Thakur
LSG's shocker in the field continues. Thakur draws top edge on the bouncer, but Bishnoi has run in too far at deep midwicket, and has to backtrack and makes a mess of this

that's Gaikwad's hundred. In just 56 balls. His second IPL hundred. Thakur misses his wide yorker again. Gaikwad gets a half-volley, which he drives over extra cover. Removes his helmet and holds his arms aloft. Bat in one hand, helmet in the other
full and straight. Misses the yorker by a foot, and that's all Gaikwad needs to smash it over long-on for a six. Moves to 99
goes for the wide yorker again, ends up bowling a low fullie, Dube gets a thick edge, and the short third is fine enough to field this
nails the wide yorker now. Beats him. Gets a dot

wide yorker, but just too wide. Rahul is wondering if it should be reviewed. Long debate with the umpire for some reason. Finally the umpire accepts the review. Dube's back foot is marginally outside off when the bowler releases. The ball is just outside the wide line. "Nothing conclusive to overturn the on-field call," says the third umpire
full and wide, beats Gaikwad's attempt to play the sweep to capitalise on the strong off-side field. Goode comeback from Mohsin to end up with just eight off the over
slower ball, short of a length, wide outside off, punched to deep cover for one
wide length ball, just the single

slower ball now, short of a length, and well outside off. Beats his cut. Not called a wide because Gaikwad has moved across. Gaikwad still reviews it, You are never going to get these overturned. He is well outside off before the ball is released. You are never going to get a third umpire overrule his colleague when this happens
on a length, on-pace, Gaikwad tries to sweep him but is beaten by the pace
CSK are well and truly going from both ends. Short, not much pace, sits up, and Gaikwad pulls it over square leg for another six. Into the 90s now
full and wide, drilled straight to extra cover
short of a length, outside off, bottom-edges the pull to the keeper. A rare dot

Thakur stays off pace, on a length, no room, and Dube still manages to hit him for a six. This is by no means a clean hit. He has got way more height on it than distance, but there are no half measures with Dube and he has managed to just clear long-on
and this is what happens when he nails them. Thakur goes short, slower ball again, and Dube pulls it 20 rows back over midwicket. Not too high. Just waist high
slower ball, but full enough and on the pads, and Dube is in too good a form to miss out. Not the cleanest connection but he has hit it well enough for a six wide of long-on
slower ball, on a length, not much room, steered to deep point for one
short of a length, no room, Gaikwad still manages a single to point
makes room early, Gaikwad tries to follow him with hard length, he comes back to his original mark and pulls it to the left of long leg for two
down the leg side, called a wide. Lucky that Gaikwad hasn't got a tickle on this
slower ball, short of a length, punched to deep cover for one
in his wheelhouse with mid-off up, and Stoinis is asking to be hit. Punched hard and straight of mid-off, all along the ground. Three bad balls so far. Two have been put away
looks for a big hit to a full ball, but gets a thick inside edge for a single. Gaikwad is looking to clear mid-off, but fails to do so
well that shuts me up. Intent from both ends. A gentle short ball from Stoinis at 124ks, and Gaikwad doesn't even bother transferring his eight back. Hoicks it over midwicket for six
misses the yorker, gives him a full toss, but Gaikwad just taps it to deep midwicket for one
walks at him, Henry shortens the length, he pulls it square of deep midwicket for two
short of a length, no room, pulled to short midwicket
slower ball, middle and off, on a length, Dube takes just the single to point
short of a length, not much room, punched straight to point
looks to tuck him up with a short ball, but it well down leg, and Dube helps it along for a four to fine leg
short of a length, angling in, opens the face, gets a single to deep third
first six of the innings, and guess whose bat? Dube's. Cross-seam, on a length, angling in, and he has lofted it back over Stoinis' head for a huge six
short of a length, tucks him up, pulled to deep backward square for one
on a length, outside off, punched to backward point
hard length, outside off, pushed with an open face for a single
full, into the pads, Dube pushes it to midwicket. Just getting a sighter in
full and straight, punched wide of mid-off for one
slower bouncer, Jadeja tries to pull, and ends up gloving it to KL Rahul. Hardly any celebration from LSG. Do you really want the wicket oof Jadeja when he is going at under a run a ball?
on a length, outside off, punched to deep cover for a single
short of a length, slower ball, cut to the left of deep cover for two
lovely shot. Nothing wrong with this ball. It is a length ball headed for top of off, and he has managed to place it to the right of backward point and to the left of deep cover
short of a length, into the body, pulled to long leg
down leg again, and he is lucky to get away with just a single to short fine leg
full, outside off, 103ks, driven to deep cover for a single
a rare bad ball from Pandya. Fired into the pads, the idea is to cramp him up, but slides down leg, and Gaikwad helps it along to long leg
this is like a seam-up delivery at 104ks, short of a length, wide outside off, punched down to long-off for one
on a length, 100ks, middle and leg, opens the face, takes a single
down the wicket, Pandya keeps firing it in at 103ks, pushed to extra cover
short of a length, 122ks, pulled to the left of deep midwicket, comes back for the second
on a length, no room, opens the face, takes a single to point
driven on the up as Thakur goes back to hard length, and he has placed it in front of deep cover for two
takes out the ramp as Thakur goes shorter. It is bowled at 128ks with spongy bounce, and Gaikwad has enough time to adjust and guide it over the keeper's head
short of a length, pulled to deep midwicket for one
short of a length, no room, runs this down to deep third
on a length, straight, pushes to cover, and takes the single to bring up his fifty
he has split long-on and deep midwicket. Nothing wrong with the ball. Short of a length, no room, and Gaikwad manages to pull it between the two fielders
short of a length, 103ks, no room, helped to short fine for one
fired in again, 104ks, on a length, middle and leg, punched down to long-on for one
pushed through again, pulled down to long-on for one
fires this in as he sees Jadeja advance. Draws a defensive push
short of as length, not much room, punched in front of deep cover for a couple

big shout for lbw as this short-of-a-length ball has skidded on and beaten him. I think he has been given not-out on height. LSG review. Misses the bat clearly but hit above the knee roll of the pad. Stoinis is already setting the field before the ball tracking shows the ball sailing over. LSG lose the review
Jadeja goes past a run a ball. This is a proper bouncer, and Jadeja has hooked this down and in front of short fine for four
short, into the body, helps it along with a pull, but finds short fine leg
short of a length, outside off, cut away to deep point
on a length, no room, tucked away through square leg for two between deep square and deep midwicket
quick, short of a length, angling across him, beats his attempt to cut
full and wide, a touch too full, and Jadeja manages to drag it for a straight lofted hit. Gets four straight of long-on. First boundary in 14 balls
slows it down, flights it, driven down to long-off for a single
quick, on a length, no room, 99ks, pushed to cover
full toss, hit straight of long-on, and Henry makes a sliding save to keep them to one
looks like a wrong'un, Gaikwad opens the face and takes a single to point
charges at Thakur, who strays short of a len gth, and all he can manage is a hit back to Thakur
beaten on the inside edge again, this time on the pull as Thakur goes short of a length
seam movement. Again it looks like top of off, but jags back in to beat Jadeja's inside edge
on a length, top of off, punched to short cover

LSG finally hold on to one. That silences the crowd. Short of a length, pulled away hard, times the pants off it, but Hooda takes the catch at midwicket. Not straight at him either. Overhead, slightly to his left
full, middle and leg, gets away with it as Gaikwad just tucks it away for one
on a length, just outside off, opens the face, gets a single to point
on a length, middle and leg, pushed to long-on for one
short of a length, not much room, opens the face, gets a single to point
lovely late-cut. He is caught on the front foot to a shortish ball, but opens the face late to it, and beats deep point to his left
looks like a slower ball to me. Yes it is, at 121ks. Pushed to mid-off
Gaikwad has been in some driving form tonight. Again on the up, well forward, and places to the left of short cover and to the right of cover-point
full and wide, another misfield at extra cover, another single gifted
full, nearly a yorker, driven down to long-off for one
finally bowls the good length, drives this down to long-off
uppish square-cut. Thick edge, loopy, lot of time for backward point to get there, but it still evades Matt Henry. Just about
lovely square-drive. Bishnoi goes full and wide again, he uses his wrists and an open face to drive this between backward point and cover-point
full and wide, swept to deep midwicket
short cover is sharp on that tip-and-run, and denies their attempt to take that run
tucked away off the hip to long leg, and they steal a second again
this one seams in towards top of middle, and they tip and run again
signs of slowness already. Throws his bat at a wide length ball, but ends up dragging it to short midwicket
wide and full, Mitchell drives in the air and wide of mid-off. Pooran gives it a big chase and saves two. This time, CSK have been caught napping. They could have taken three here
slogs at a length ball, hits it uppishly, but it bounces just short of midwicket
short of a length, Gaikwad opens the face, straight to deep third almost, and they steal a second again. Rahul looks angry. Sloppy two overs of fielding
this time off the front foot. On the up still. Not a half-volley by any means. Still driven handsomely through cover
and now a lovely back-foot drive. Slightly short of a length, some width, and he crashes it in front of backward point for four
and now dropped. Mohsin Khan has walked under ladders today. Heavy ball, good length, takes the thick edge on the drive, goes for a head-high catch to short third, where Yash Thakur drops it
short of a length, gets some width, punches it to backward point where Badoni lets the ball through his legs for four. Should have been a dot
on a length, just outside off, pushed past point

superb catch by KL Rahul. They have just moved the slip wide, and for a second I think that has cost them a wicket. This is the only full ball this over, draws the drive, holds its line, and takes a healthy edge. An easy grab for first slip if in regulation position, but now Rahul has to make up for it with a one-handed diving grab
on a length, shape back in, pushed to mid-on
on a length, just outside off, steered straight to Mohsin this time
short of a length, outside off, opens the face, sends it past backward point. Mohsin at deep third is a little casual, and they steal the second
left alone outside off. This one moves after going past the wicket
on a length, top of off, Rahane drops and runs. Well, he looks up, sees Gaikwad coming and responds. A single stolen

Stoinis has done the unthinkable! 124 off 63, and LSG have beaten CSK in their own den. Banged in short on middle, he gets across and pulls him over short fine leg. The crowd is stunned into silence. He removes his helmet and hugs Hooda. That is some win.

Edged and four! Stoinis is doing it in a hurry, and it is a no-ball as well. Oh, dear! Low full toss well outside off. Stoinis throws his hands at it, gets a thick outside edge that races to the right of short third
Straight as an arrow and surely this is LSG's game now. Fuller outside off, he steps across and muscles this over the bowler's head. The crowd is stunned.
Six off the first ball! That is some shot and he has silenced the crowd. Fizz goes on pace and misses the yorker. In Stoinis' arc outside off. He gets across and tonks him over long-on
Straight over the bowler's head. Was on a length on middle, he lofts it but not as cleanly. Shardul sprints to his left and saves two
Play and a miss! Gold dust at this stage. Was a back of a length ball on middle. He stays leg side of the ball and looks for a cut, but misses
Hits it down the ground and Hooda gets another boundary. Oh, this match is turning LSG's way. Length ball on middle. He stays deep in crease and thumps him to the left of long-on
Edged and past Dhoni. But Chahar is very fine and should cut it off. Oh, he doesn't. Gets across but lets the ball through his legs.
Excellent yorker just outside off and Stoinis can only get it to extra cover. Gets the set batter off strike
SLAMMED! Was a length ball outside off, he clears his front leg and muscles it to the left of extra cover. Not a soul moved

Pulls it over deep backward square leg and Hooda has got an important boundary away. Keeps LSG in the chase. Banged in short on the hips of the batter, who helps it over Chahar. He leapt and got both hands to it but failed to reign the ball in
Another low full toss outside off, he lifts it towards long-off
Hundred for Stoinis, his first in IPL. Gets there off 56 balls. Some knock this. On pace full ball outside off, he screeches this away to the left of deep cover. His is not done yet

Not a wide? Nope, not given. Low full toss well outside off. Was very close to the tramline but the batter also moved across. He leaves it alone. Stoinis calls for a review. The third umpire confirms it was a fair call.

Gets hold of this one, and sends it miles over deep midwicket. Was the slower offcutter again. A back of a length ball outside off, The difference was the ball sat up for Stoinis who pulled it with some power.
Angles the length ball across Stoinis who gives the slower ball a wild hack but can't make a connection.

Huge, huge appeal for lbw but the umpire stays unmoved. Was that sliding down leg? Looks like but CSK have reviewed. It was a pinpoint yorker from Pathirana bang on leg stump. Hits Stoinis flush on the boot. No bat involved. Ah, replays confirm the ball was pitching just outside leg stump. Stoinis survives but that was a top over from Pathirana
Juust past backward point but Stoinis gets the boundary. Was a short of a length ball outside off, he cuts it to the right of the diving fielder to enter the 90s
Gets a length ball at 143.3kph outside that he scythes to deep point

That goes straight up and Pooran has perished! Pathirana wins the battle yet again. Was in the slot outside off, as Pooran looked to straight down the ground. But he could only slice it and Shardul coming in from long-off takes a comfortable-enough catch
Short and wide, he thrashes it to extra cover where Mooen flings to his right and saves a few runs
Bouncer to start off and a good one at that around shoulder high. Stoinis looks for a ramp but is late into his shot
Fuller in length outside off, he gets across and drills it to long off.
Back of a length ball outside off, he miscues his slap to long off

Lands in between three fielder. Oh the rub of the green going Pooran's way. Low full toss outside off, he miscues it completely but as luck would have it the ball falls in no-mand land with none of long-off, extra cover or deep cover able to reach it
16 off 3! Slower 115.3kph length ball outside off, but again in Pooran's arc. He gets a free swing and deposits him over wide long-on
Misfield and four. Oh, pressure, pressure. Low full toss outside off, he scythes it to deep point. Chahar gets across, reaches it comfortably but lets the ball through
BANG! Length ball well outside off stump but right in the arc for Pooran. He frees his arms and pummels him miles over the deep extra cover fence
Dot ball to end the over. Angles the length ball across Stoinis who was looking for a dab to deep third, but misses

Oh, that's a top shot from Stoinis. Slower offcutter on off stump, Stoinis this time was ready for it. He backs away, waits for the ball and goes straight over the bowler's head and over the ropes eventually.
On-pace fuller ball outside off, he drills it down to long-on
Pooran gets going. Was a fuller length ball around the tramline outside off. Pooran steps across, bends down on one knee and lofts him to the right of long off.
117.1kph back of a length ball angling across Stoinis who is caught off guard and feebly pushes towards extra cover
Fuller length ball outside off, he jams it to long-on
On a length on leg stump, he flicks it to deep midwicket's right for a couple of runs
Another shin-high full toss outside off outside off. This time Pooran slices it to deep point
Glorious drive. Not easy to get that away, but Pooran does it so well. Low full toss outside off but Pooran stays low and drills the drive past extra cover. That was bowled at 149kph
Low full toss outside off at 149.5kph. He scythes it to deep cover
Lovely delivery. Gets the length ball outside off at 149kph. Stoinis was way too late on his shot.
Fuller and outside off, he drives to extra cover

Full and very wide outside off stump. Stoinis moved right across his off stump, but still that looked comfortably wide. Dhoni though has asked Gaikwad to review. What do I know. Dhoni is on point with his review. The third umpire says as the batter moved, so did the wide line and confirms the ball is fair

What was the height on that? Above the waist? The umpires don't seem inclined. And Stoinis has asked for a review. Definitely looked high on first glance. Was on middle stump and Stonis hoicked it over square leg for four. The question remains whether that was above the waist. Yep, it was confirms the third umpire. This is an expensive over already and still a free-hit to come
Short and wide outside off, he cuts it but off the toe-end of the blade to the right of deep cover
Another low full toss outside off, he scythes to the left of deep point where Mitchell does well to sprint across and restrict them to two
Flat, hard and six! That has been muscled away by Stoinis. Low full toss angling across the batter. He gets back and across and thumps him over the extra cover fence
Low full toss well outside off, he slaps it hard but straight to Jadeja at deep point
nicely bowled. Saw Stoinis walk right across shaping for the scoop and got the ball well outside off. Stoinis adjusts and drives to long off only for a run
Length on off stump, he pushes to long on
Slower bouncer but that was too high. He had Stoinis deceived just got the height wrong. Loops over Stoinis
Slashed to deep point. Was a slower length ball at 119.1kph ball well outside off. He reaches for it and carves to Chahar
Slower back of a length ball outside off. He pulls it to deep midwicket
Fuller in length outside off, he digs it out to the right of extra cover
On pace length ball outside off, he opens the face of the bat and gets it to deep third
Edged just past Dhoni. Length ball well outside off around the tramline. Stoinis throws his hands at it, gets an under-edge that beat Dhoni's right

Pathirana has ended Padikkal's misery with a searing 151.1kph length ball. He gets the ball at pace on leg stump. Padikkal stays leg side of the ball, does not move his feet much and just looks to feebly defend. Misses and sees his leg pole flattened
Slower bouncer does him in. On middle stump, Padikkal does not spot it early and was deceived. The ball goes through to the keeper
Slower short of a length ball anglling across Padikkal but it was just outside the tramline.
Pacy length ball at 134.2kph on middle stump. He stays back and pushes to long-on
Too short, called a wide. Goes for the bouncer outside off.  Good idea, just the execution went a touch awry
Fuller-length ball outside off, drives to extra cover
Wide yorker well outside off, he reaches it and slices to deep third
Starts off by nailing the yorker on middle stump. Stoinis can just dig it out to mid-off. Takes a quick single even as the throw comes in
Bahut badhiya (Very good) says Dhoni as Jadeja bowls a length ball quick and outside off. Stoinis pats to deep point
Length outside off, he drills it to extra cover on the bounce and a slight misfield allows him to steal a single
Gives himself a lot of room too early. Jadeja spots it and darts it quick and wide of off stump. He has to let the ball go
Flatter outside off, he pushes to cover and takes a quick run
Oh, how has that missed leg stump? Dragged halfway down on leg stump. Padikkal looks to power this away across the line, but makes no connection. Oh, that should have been put into the stands
Fifty for Stoinis off just 26 balls. Just what LSG needed at this stage. Gets there with a push to long on
Backs away big time outside leg stump. Moeen darts the ball in at 101kph on leg stump and Padikkal is content to just push it towards extra cover
Floated on a length on middle and leg, he stays back and ticks it with soft hands to deep midwicket. Takes two more
Floated on middle stump, Padikkal can only drag it to long-on
Slower length ball outside off, he stays back and pats it past point
HUUUUGE! Floated outside off, right in Stoinis's wheelhouse. He clears his front leg, one step forward and swings through the line to pump it 96m over long-on
That's a lovely sweep from Stoinis. Was bowled slower and well outside off. He gets down on one knee, fetches the ball and clatters it in the gap between midwicket and deep square
The catch is taken but won't count obviously. The no-ball doesn't end up costing CSK much. He darts that outside off. Stoinis carves it to deep extra cover, who takes the catch
Darted in at 101.3kph on leg stump, Padikkal whisks it to deep backward square leg. Jadeja has overstepped as well.  Not for the first time this season.
Flatter on middle and leg, he ticks it to wide long on

Gives him the charge and clears long-on. Floats this up just a touch on leg stump. Stoinis jumps down, goes through with the shot even though he did not get under the ball and with the power he possesses clears the fielder with ease
Quicker on middle and leg, he stays back and bunts it to the on-side. That was fired in at 101.1kph
Flatter at 98.2kph outside off. He shapes up for the cut but misses
Fuller on leg stump, he stays leg side of the ball and drives to long off
Pushed quicker and outside off, he stays back and thrashes it to deep cover. Six singles off that over.
Flatter down leg but Padikkal, in the form that he is in, can't cash in. Looks to leather it past short fine. The ball catches his glove to short fine
A tad short on off stump, he stays back and slaps to long-on
Fullish on leg stump, he backs away and opens up the off side driving to long off
Floated outside off, he hammers it past the bowler's left
Loopy full ball on middle, he bunts it to long on
Slashes it to deep cover. Was a length ball outside off. He gives himself room by backing away but can't take full toll
On a length just outside off, he opens the face of the bat past point for a run.
On a length on middle and leg, he works it to the right of mid-on
Length outside off, he mistimes towards cover for a run
Two in two. Another short of a length ball outside off. Stoinis waits for the ball and thumps him over extra cover.
Loosener first up and punished. Short, wide outside off. Stoinis cuts him over point.
Length ball angling back into Padikkal who pushes back to the bowler
Fullish length ball outside off, he steps forward and drives to extra cover

He gets his man and that's the big wicket of Rahul! Excellent captaincy, excellent bowling. He had closed the angle and that meant Rahul had to create extra room. Steps to the leg side but Fizz has kept the ball right on off stump on a length. Rahul slaps it only as far as Gaikwad who is right on the circle at extra cover
Another swish and a miss. Was a good length outside off. He looks to thrash it away, does not connect

Ooh, how's that missed the stumps? He cramps Rahul for room but the length was the key. Angles the ball on around the length area on off as Rahul tried to give himself room. Misses and the ball just goes over the off pole
Caresses him through extra cover first ball. On a length just outside off. He gives himself just a hint of room and finds the gap between cover and mid-off.
On a length on off stump, pushed back to the bowler
One bounce and over the ropes. Gentle back of a length ball outside off. The ball just sits up for Stoinis who pumps it over mid-on. Did not connect as cleanly, but enough to clear the fielder
Slower length ball on leg stump. Rahul stays leg side of the ball and works it to cow corner
Back of a length ball on middle, he pulls to the left of deep midwicket
Another skiddy inswinger on off and middle stump. It was on a length and Stoinis just about gets an inside edge back onto his pad towards point
Good length ball shaping back into the Stoinis around off stump. He stands tall and pushes to mid-off
On a length on off stump, he ticks it to mid-on
He throws his bat at it and gets four. Back of a length ball well outside off. The width was the key. He flashes at it and flashes hard to the right of deep third
Full again with a hint of shape back into Stoinis who flicks it to midwicket
Laces the cover drive and beats the mid-off fielder. Fuller in length just outside off. There was still some swing on display. But Stoinis met it with a full face and drove past Gaikwad.
Length ball at134.3kph on middle and leg, he whisks it away to deep midwicket
Wild swing and a miss. Length ball outside off continuing to shape away from Rahul. He gives himself room and gives it an almighty whack. Only connects at thin air

Loud appeal for lbw, not given and CSK don't review. Good length ball skidding back into Rahul on middle and leg. He shapes up for the pull but the ball does not rise enough and hits him on the pad. Was probably going over the stumps

Trouble, trouble but Stonis makes it back, just in time. Good length ball cutting back into Rahul who mistimes towards extra cover. Stoinis was halfway down but got back just in time even as the throw missed the stumps
Aggression and the shot comes off! Was a back of a length just outside off. Rahul jumps down the track, gives himself a bit of room and hammers him up and over the cover fence. A shot of authority
Some shape back into Rahul once more. Was a good length ball on off stump, he gets an under-edge towards point
Length ball on middle and leg, Rahul gets across and works it neatly to the left of deep backward square leg for a couple of runs
Good length ball to start off with a tad bit of shape away from Stoinis. He gets it down to deep third for a run with an open face
Loads of swing for Chahar and just about kept out by Rahul. Was full and boomerangs sharply back into Rahul on off and middle. He digs it to mid-on. Chahar has his hand on his head
back of a length ball with some shape away from Stoinis who opens the face of the bat and guides to deep third for a run
Ooh, some tail back in for Chahar. Was a length ball well outside off, and met Stoinis around the fourth stump.

Cleans him up! A drag on and LSG have been rocked just three balls into the chase. Gentle length ball angling across de Kock, who feebly reaches for the ball away from his body, gets an inside-edge and the ball clatters into his stump. Chahar is pumped, the crowd is pumped. CSK are away.
Drilled hard but straight to extra cover who makes a good stop. Ruturaj it is who made that save. Would have stung. Was a touch too full outside off and de Kock nailed the cover drive
A hint of inward shape in Chahar on a length on middle and leg. He works it to midwicket
